nodes.name: KMnO4 immersion for triple defense
nodes.procedure: The self-supported CoP nanowire catalyst on NF was immersed in KMnO₄ solution. The surface of CoP oxidizes into other Co and P species due to surface MnO₄⁻ adsorption, and MnO₂ forms on the solid-liquid interface. Such spontaneous redox reactions between MnO₄⁻ and CoP create surface well-dispersed MnO₂ and Co-Pi in situ to filter out Cl⁻ as strong selective dual barriers and change the arrangement and surface roughness of nanowires to constitute a more specialized cage-like array structure.
nodes.source_text: The target electrode was synthesized using a self-supported CoP nanowire catalyst as a precursor by simple immersion within a KMnO₄ solution. The surface of CoP oxidizes into other Co and P species due to surface MnO₄⁻ adsorption...

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP/NF shows peaks for CoP (PDF#29-0497) and Ni substrate. MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF shows CoP peaks with weakened intensities and additional γ-MnO2 peaks at 22.4°, 37.1°, 42.5°, 56.3° (PDF#14-0644). Co-Pi@CoP/NF shows reduced CoP crystallinity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern of CoP/NF shows peaks for CoP (PDF#29-0497) and the Ni substrate. XRD pattern of MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF still shows peaks of CoP. Also, peaks at 22.4°, 37.1°, 42.5°, and 56.3° that belong to γ-MnO2 (PDF#14-0644) are also present... the diffraction peaks of CoP, with little shift but weakened intensities, are attributed to surface oxidation... As for Co-Pi@CoP/NF, the anodic polarization treatment also reduces the crystallinity of CoP...

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP/NF shows no distinct bands 700-1250 cm⁻¹. Co-Pi@CoP/NF and MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF show P-species bands at 984.9, 1060.5 cm⁻¹ (HPO₄²⁻, PO₄³⁻). MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF shows additional Mn-O band at 651.5 cm⁻¹ for γ-MnO2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: CoP/NF has no distinct Raman spectral bands over a wide range of 700 to 1250 cm⁻¹, but Co-Pi@CoP/NF and MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF both show Raman bands at 984.9 and 1060.5 cm⁻¹ belonging to phosphorus species like HPO₄²⁻ and PO₄³⁻ (Supplementary Fig. 2), again indicating the successful introduction of phosphate-related species. Also, only MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF has a distinguishable Raman band at 651.5 cm⁻¹ (Mn-O), which is attributed to γ-MnO2.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP/NF shows random nanowire arrangement. MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF shows tip-connected nanocage-like array with rougher surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images of CoP/NF (Fig. 2b) and MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF (Fig. 2c) reveal two rather different morphological architectures composed of nanowires with similar sizes.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM identifies CoP core (0.172 nm, (103) plane), amorphous Co-Pi (~9 nm thick), dispersed MnO2 nanoparticles (0.217 nm, (300) plane).
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images (Fig. 2e) identify the internal CoP core, amorphous Co-Pi, and dispersed MnO2 nanoparticles... The good crystallinity of both MnO2 and CoP are supported by a lattice spacing of 0.217 nm that corresponds to the (300) plane of MnO2 as well as a spacing of 0.172 nm that matches with the (103) plane of CoP.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS confirms uniform distribution of Co, P, O, and Mn elements throughout MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP nanowires.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy data (Fig. 2f) can verify the uniform distribution of Co, P, O, and Mn elements throughout the one-dimensional MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co 2p: CoP shows Coδ+ (777.6, 792.5 eV, Co-P) and Co²+ (780.8, 797.1 eV); higher oxidized Co in Co-Pi@CoP and MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP. P 2p: P-M (128.9 eV), P-O (133.6 eV); P-M content decreases CoP > Co-Pi@CoP > MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP. Mn 3s/2p confirm MnO2 formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution Co 2p XPS spectra of CoP, Co-Pi@CoP, and MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP... As for CoP, peaks of Coδ+ 2p3/2 and Coδ+ 2p1/2 appear at 777.6 and 792.5 eV... The P 2p XPS spectrum of CoP is divided into P-O (133.6 eV) and P-metal (P-M, 128.9 eV)... XPS spectra in Mn 3s and Mn 2p regions for MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP confirm the successful fabrication of MnO2...

nodes.characterization_summary: Post-eASO Cl 2p XPS shows strongest Cl peak for CoP/NF, weaker for Co-Pi@CoP/NF, weakest for MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF with minimal Co-Cl bonding. After 3000h test, almost no Cl species on MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XPS spectra in the Cl 2p region for the corresponding electrodes after stability tests at 2 A cm⁻² (Fig. 3c) show the strongest peak intensity for CoP, a slightly weakened peak intensity for Co-Pi@CoP, and the weakest peak intensity of MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP... almost no chlorine species can be found on MnO2@Co-Pi@CoP/NF after the 3000-h durability test...
